_comment: Append-only detector label registry (docs/NEW_CARDS_PLAN.md 2.3 and 7, item N07). Read by tools/vision_autolabel.py.

These labels are APPENDED to the label set scripts/prepare_yolo_dataset.py wrote (tmp/yolo/detector_labels.json, 155 labels x 2 sides = 310 classes on the owner's PC on 2026-10-30). Label k of this list is label len(base) + k, YOLO classes 2 (len(base) + k) + side. ultralytics 8.4.192 copies the learned class rows by name when the class count grows (nn/tasks.py _remap_cls_by_names), so the old classes survive a fine-tune.

APPEND ONLY: never remove, rename or reorder an entry, or every later class index moves and the pinned weights read the wrong names. The old yolo_names() must stay a prefix of the new ones: `tools/vision_autolabel.py labels --against <older extended detector_labels.json>` checks it.

Each entry: label (a detector key: the canonical unit name of a class form as tools/vision_classes.py ClassTable.detector_key gives it, or a spell card name); card (the deck card, a catalogue name); type (unit, tower or spell); form (base, evo or hero); base (form entries only: the base-form label it falls back to); train_as (null: a form trains as its base label while it has fewer than thin_tracks labelled tracks, a base label as itself; "self": always itself; a label name: always that label); valid_from_client (null, or the first client version whose look this label learns: sessions recorded on an older client are not used for it); phase, added, note: provenance.

reworks: {label: client version} for a label already in the base set whose look changed in a rework; owner sessions older than that version are not used for it. KataCR frames have no client and are not filtered.

Every entry must resolve through scripts/vision/labels.resolve_label against data/vision/classes.json (tests/pipeline/test_label_registry.py). A card the client has but classes.json lacks cannot be added until the table is regenerated (plan 7.3).

base.note: tmp/yolo/detector_labels.json from scripts/prepare_yolo_dataset.py on the owner's PC, 2026-10-30 (KataCR names through data/vision/classes.json). digest stays null until the owner reports that file's label-set digest; once set, extending any other base is refused.
